verdicts.reason: Both use the same unchanged block, just shrunk. In the original, the red T bleeds off the top, right and bottom edges. Here it floats as a small cutout with blue margins all round, so it loses the bold full-frame feel, and the headline only fills about 40% of the canvas. A at least centres the block vertically, though large empty bands remain above and below. B pins it to the top and leaves roughly the bottom 35% as dead blue space, which makes it badly lopsided.
